title: Add option to link to ToS, privacy notice, etc in the register file
body: For people (like ourselves) hosting PODs for others, there needs to be a privacy policy, Terms of Service, and stuff like that in place, and we need to link to it from the register account page. I suppose we might need to have a box that they can tick to indicate that they're read it too.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: I would like to take this up!

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
@mintunitish give it a go ^_^

This is my proposal for how to solve it:
- Add an option to the init-script where the service-provider can link to their terms of service (it should either take no value or a valid URL as input)
- If option is in use, link to it from the register account page
- If option is in use, add checkbox that needs to checked to be able to create account

You can use the same methods I used in https://github.com/solid/node-solid-server/pull/869, namely `processHandlebarFile` in `lib/common/template-utils.js` to handle the variables.

comments.author: Participant 3
